responsibility: Builds and repairs RTL control-flow graphs from the linear instruction stream. It decides which RTL insns belong inside a basic block, which insns terminate control flow, creates label, normal, and EH edges from machine instructions, discovers new basic-block boundaries after expansion or later instruction insertion, rescans affected regions with `find_many_sub_basic_blocks`, purges dead edges, and recomputes outgoing edge probabilities/counts when CFG structure has been regenerated from RTL.
same_name_distinction: Implements RTL-specific CFG construction and repair from the instruction stream, including insn classification, edge creation, block splitting, and probability recomputation; unlike gcc/cfgbuild.h, it contains the actual builder logic rather than just the exported entry points for that RTL layer.
